verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a keyboard-driven editor in thin outline: typing `[[]]` and `(())` creates page and block references, a `/query` slash command exists, and users report an embedded PDF reader. None of the specific formatting elements (headings, callouts, tables, code blocks) are documented. On speed, hands-on reports say block editing lags and pasting a few paragraphs of long-form text can freeze the editor. missing for 10: documented headings, callouts, tables and code blocks; documented embedding of images/video in notes; evidence of a fast editor with no reported lag on long text.
